clauses.clause: You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color.
clauses.evidence: Tree abilities[0] = the compiler's B4-spend-any-color form: StaticAbility(OptionalEffect(MANA_POLICY scope ALL_YOURS)). The trace has no spend of colored mana with the card out, so it never shows the permission at work. Packs on the live tree: I04_1 (one colorless mana pays Shock's {R} with the Orrery out: Shock resolves), I04_3 (the Orrery's own five mana pays the {R}, four stay in the pool), I04_2 (the same cast is refused, 'cost:mana:R', when the Orrery is the opponent's: only its controller may spend that way). I04_8 (one colorless mana pays Scavenging Ooze's {G} activation with the Orrery out: the permission covers abilities too) and its control I04_9 (no Orrery: refused, 'cost:mana').

[activate [1] from battlefield]: 'card becomes tapped', ABILITY_ACTIVATED, 'you: mana C+5' (exactly five colorless; the tap is the only cost). Pack I04_3 pays a cast by tapping it: the Orrery taps, five mana are made and four colorless remain after Shock's {R}.

clauses.clause: {5}, {T}: Draw a card for each color among permanents you control.
clauses.evidence: The cost is shown ([activate [2]]: 'card becomes tapped', 'you: mana C-5') and two cards are drawn, but the colors of the standard board's permanents are not in the trace, so the count of colors (colorless not counted, a color counted once, only your own permanents) is not pinned by it. Packs on the live tree: I04_4 (red twice, white twice, blue once, colorless permanents and the opponent's green and black: exactly 3 cards), I04_5 (only colorless permanents of yours and colored ones of the opponent's: 0 cards, cost still paid), I04_6 (four mana: refused, 'cost:mana_generic:4<5'), I04_7 (tapped Orrery: refused, 'cost:tap:source_tapped'). Control, not ownership: I04_10 (colors among permanents you control: a stolen green creature counts, your red one taken from you does not: 1 card), I04_11 (the Orrery you gain control of gives you the permission). Through the menu: I04_12 (the Orrery and four Forests: no row for the draw ability, it cannot pay its own {5} by tapping itself), I04_13 (five Forests: offered, all six permanents tap, one card for the one color).
